def transform3(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    ones=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    if not ones:return out
    rows={r for r,c in ones}; cols={c for r,c in ones}
    if len(ones)>=5 and len(rows)==len(cols) and len(rows)==(len(ones)+1)//2:
        left=min(ones,key=lambda x:x[1]); right=max(ones,key=lambda x:x[1])
        rays=[(left[0],left[1],-1,-1),(right[0],right[1],-1,1)]
    else:
        r,c=max(ones);rays=[(r,c,1,1)]
    for r,c,dr,dc in rays:
        while True:
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not(0<=nr<len(grid) and 0<=nc<len(grid[0])):break

                dr=-dr;nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                if not(0<=nr<len(grid) and 0<=nc<len(grid[0])) or grid[nr][nc]==2:break
            out[nr][nc]=1;r,c=nr,nc
    return out
